label: Multi-phase repo build with install and test docs
description: Build a multi-phase local tool in a git repo that captures agent sessions, redacts data, stores them in a database, and proposes reusable artifacts. Includes a review CLI, installers, README sections, and unit tests, with pushes to a remote.
type_rationale: A long, phase-by-phase engineering effort that needs planning and decisions, so no single script fits. A skill can guide the phases and call scripts for install and test steps.
